description: This Java class provides services for processing payments via ClearCommerce, including authorization, capture, release, refund, reauthorization, and reporting functionalities. It constructs XML requests, sends them over HTTP, and parses XML responses, handling various transaction types and errors.

classes.name: ClearCommerceException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to ClearCommerce communication, extending GeneralException.

methods.name: buildPrimaryTxRequest
methods.description: Constructs an XML Document for primary transactions (authorization, credit) with payment details, addresses, and transaction info.

methods.name: buildSecondaryTxRequest
methods.description: Builds an XML Document for secondary transactions (capture, release, refund, re-auth) using reference number and transaction type.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Serializes XML request, sends it via HTTP POST to ClearCommerce server, and parses the XML response.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Extracts list of messages with severity from the response XML document.

methods.name: getMessageListMaxSev
methods.description: Returns the maximum severity level among messages in the response XML.

methods.name: getReferenceNum
methods.description: Retrieves the reference number from the response XML document.

methods.name: processAuthResponse
methods.description: Parses authorization response XML and returns a map with result details and messages.

methods.name: processCreditResponse
methods.description: Parses credit response XML and returns a map with result details and messages.

methods.name: processCaptureResponse
methods.description: Parses capture response XML and returns a map with result details and messages.

methods.name: processReleaseResponse
methods.description: Parses release response XML and returns a map with result details and messages.

methods.name: processRefundResponse
methods.description: Parses refund response XML and returns a map with result details and messages.

methods.name: processReAuthResponse
methods.description: Parses re-authorization response XML and returns a map with result details and messages.
